headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • Consolidated revenue at Rs1,780 cr (+28.5% yoy, +14.0 % qoq) was above our estimate. • Plywood grew by 30% yoy (+14% qoq) to Rs972 cr; plywood volume growth was strong at 21 % yoy (11% qoq). • Plywood segment EBITDA margin was healthy at 15.8% (210 bps yoy).

Negatives: • Consolidated EBITDA margin at 12.9% was below our estimate of 13.4%. • Volume growth in MDF at 9% yoy moderated sharply as compared to the performance over the past many quarters. • In Q2FY27, MDF margins remained soft at 8.8% (vs 13.6% in Q2FY26).

(EBITDA: Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortization; MDF: Medium Density Fiber Board; PE: Price/Earnings) ` ` ` The content of this document has been derived from Kotak Securities PCG research report.
